front:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: ONE orthographic FRONT reference image for multi-view 3D reconstruction of the LITHIDE PALADIN for Dungeon Empire.
Reference image1 is the approved four-hero comparison. Use ONLY the SECOND character from the left: the squat stone paladin with gold trim and glowing yellow eyes. The fox, frog and mushroom are unrelated; do not include them. Reference image2 is the same paladin in the dungeon and only reinforces identity, not the scene or camera.
Create the SAME paladin with empty hands in a neutral symmetrical A-pose. Preserve original compact, broad, big-headed cartoon proportions, thick stone limbs, layered warm gray-beige stone plates, bold clean dark outlines and subtle hand-painted faceted shading. This is a living stone guardian, not a human with exposed skin and not silver steel armor. The face is a rounded rectangular stone great-helm: vertical central brow ridge, gold brow band with a single amber diamond at front center, narrow black angular eye opening and two small luminous amber eyes, broad pale stone cheek/face plates. No human mouth, hair, beard, horns, feathers or cape.
Torso: broad faceted stone breastplate divided by a few clear dark seams, small round gold disk at throat. Two matched rounded layered stone shoulder plates edged with gold, dark recessed elbow joints, segmented stone forearm guards and chunky stone hands. Brown leather belt around waist with single rectangular gold buckle at front. Short segmented stone hip plates, compact thick thighs and knees with restrained gold edging, broad stone boots. Body proportions match original: head about one third of total height; short sturdy legs, not a tall adult knight.
Pose: exactly straight frontal camera, level at torso, orthographic elevation, zero top-down tilt, no three-quarter perspective. Head square with torso and eyes looking straight ahead. Both arms straight 30 degrees away from vertical with relaxed open stone hands, five simple fingers separated enough to see, palms facing thighs. Legs straight, feet hip-width apart, parallel and both flat on the same baseline.
Keep both hands empty: NO hammer, shield, sword, scabbard, backpack, props or attachments. Equipment is being prepared as separate models.
Full body centered in a square canvas, crown at y8%, soles at y92%, equal margin and clear gap between arms and torso, complete silhouette. Native transparent alpha background, no floor or cast shadow, no text or labels, no turntable sheet. Uniform diffuse neutral studio light, no dramatic glow or magical particles. Crisp polished painted mobile-game concept quality, consistent sharpness head to boots.
